comment: A newly created envelope is FERMEE (closed) and not yet paired to a physical
crossing — pairing/EMBARQUEMENT/DEBARQUEMENT happen later, out of band, and
arrive as an ENV_NOT01 passage notification the ELO API pushes rather than
returns here (this stub set has nothing that produces one; nothing in the
solution consumes ENV_NOT01 yet either — see src/EDI.ELO/README.md).
sensTraversee is IMPORT, not EXPORT: UK to France is an arrival into the EU, and
the crossing direction is named from the French border's side. estTIRATA is true
with possedeContratTransport false, which is French Customs' own guidance for
emergency humanitarian aid destined for Ukraine (issue #24) and is what reduces
the envelope's requirement under ENV_CTR_RG08 to a single ENS. The declaration is
therefore an ENS rather than an export declaration.
pdf carries a real base64 PDF, because that is what the field actually holds — the
spec types it as enum: [formatbytebase64], which is wrong and was generating an
unusable C# enum until build/nswag/elo.preprocess.json corrected it. A stub that
sent the literal string 'formatbytebase64' would have hidden that bug rather than
exercised the fix. It sits inside enveloppe here; the spec's own examples put it
beside enveloppe instead, and the worker reads whichever arrived.
The 400 path is rehearsed by elo-create-envelope-rejected.json, which matches a
declaration identifier of REFUSE-ME at a higher priority.
